summary: prestwich 的 EOA 原生密钥委托 EIP 合并，把 EIP-7702 委托扩展到 ed25519 等非 ECDSA 密钥。benaadams 为 EIP-2780 加入 1,756 gas 的转账日志成本并移除已被否决的 PAY 操作码，提交并合并。ethereum 账号介绍 ERC-8211，让用户与 Agent 用链下脚本表达多步组合操作。

items.topic: 账户：EOA 原生密钥委托
items.title: 新增 EIP：EOA 原生密钥委托
items.note: （prestwich）合并，2 月 18 日提交：把 EIP-7702 委托扩展到非 ECDSA 密钥类型，新增同时支持原生密钥委托与原生密钥签名的交易类型，首个非 ECDSA 类型为 ed25519。
items.title_en: Add EIP: Native Key Delegation for EOAs
items.note_en: (prestwich), merged after submission on February 18: extends EIP-7702 delegation to non ECDSA key types, adds a transaction type supporting both native key delegation and native key signing, with ed25519 as the first non ECDSA type.

items.title: EIP-2780：加入转账日志成本并移除 PAY
items.note: （benaadams）提交并合并：去掉本次分叉已否决的 PAY 操作码；由于降低后的基础成本不再覆盖 EIP-7708 的 LOG3 转账事件，新增 TRANSFER_LOG_COST = 1,756，并更新所有派生 gas 总额与容量表。
items.title_en: EIP-2780: add a transfer log cost, remove PAY
items.note_en: (benaadams), submitted and merged: removes the PAY opcode rejected for this fork; since the reduced base cost no longer absorbs EIP-7708's LOG3 transfer event, adds TRANSFER_LOG_COST = 1,756 and updates derived gas totals and capacity tables.

The ethereum account highlighted ERC-8211, letting users and agents express multi step composable actions as an off chain script.
